headline: Senate poised to vote on AGOA Extension Act as cloture showdown looms Monday!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate held routine proceedings on July 30, confirming 66 military nominations across all service branches and passing several designations including National Whistleblower Appreciation Day and National Farmers Market Week. Two key disapproval motions—one targeting child care regulations and another addressing Iran-related hostilities—both failed to advance.
